subject.title: fix: block workspace dotenv endpoint overrides [AI]

question: Should OpenClaw reserve every workspace dotenv key ending in `_ENDPOINT`, accepting the documented migration cost for existing project-local endpoint variables?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but choosing a suffix-wide fail-closed namespace versus a narrower maintained list is a security and compatibility policy decision that code review cannot infer.

options.title: Reserve `_ENDPOINT` globally
options.body: Accept the suffix-wide workspace boundary and land after rebasing and refreshing exact-head validation.

options.title: Block registered endpoint keys only
options.body: Replace the generic suffix with an explicit or metadata-backed endpoint registry to preserve unrelated project variables at the cost of future maintenance gaps.

options.title: Pause the policy change
options.body: Keep current behavior until security/config ownership defines the permanent endpoint-source contract.

recommendation.title: Reserve `_ENDPOINT` globally
recommendation.body: Accept the suffix-wide workspace boundary and land after rebasing and refreshing exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history connects this person to the original workspace dotenv filter, the generic endpoint-routing policy, and merger responsibility for the adjacent credential boundary.
